notes: Make it your own. Two dozen new Settings toggles let you show or hide almost anything that used to be permanently on-screen - the Continue Listening card, the New-station badge, sleep timer quick buttons, the ambient backdrop, swipe gestures, bookmark buttons, watch-progress labels, the idle mini player, and more, each defaulting to how the app already looked. Podcasts gets its own dedicated Settings section. A new sort option, "Newest first", groups recently-added stations at the top. Fixed: the Continue Listening card no longer claims you were listening to something you weren't - on a fresh install it used to label an arbitrary station "Continue listening to X"; it now only appears for a real station to resume, and steps aside once something's already playing. Screen reader. Fixed: a stray "Offline" announcement on a normal, connected launch - the connectivity check both the offline banner and empty-list message rely on used to race the first screen draw on a slow start. Switches throughout Settings now announce natively as on/off. The offline banner speaks its full text and retry action together. Fixed: the mini player's swipe hint no longer leaves an invisible line in the reading order, and the Favorites tab's back button returns to Radio instead of exiting. Pravah. Chapters can now be pulled from a video's own description timestamps. Added a toggle for search suggestions; playback is steadier when removing finished items from the queue. The idle mini player is off by default now, with its own toggle. Steadier underneath. Fixed an edge case where closing the app mid-recording could leave a partial file behind. The sleep timer no longer fades a player that's already gone. Autoplay no longer occasionally slips a YouTube video into a radio queue. Hearing aids and BLE headsets are now recognised as proper audio outputs.
